title: "Wes Knipe"
---

Notes and measurements on how AI agents find, judge and pay for information.

- **[x402 Clean Index](x402/index.qmd):** a weekly, demand-cleaned view of what agents actually pay for on the x402 network. Unlike raw trackers, it removes manufactured and single-buyer volume first.
- **[x402 seller leaderboard](x402/sellers/index.qmd):** who agents actually pay, week by week, with a page per seller.
- **[AI-policy checker](check/index.qmd):** what any website tells AI crawlers: robots.txt rules for 25 AI bots, Content-Signal, RSL licence and price, TDMRep, llms.txt, and whether it charges.
- **[Which models buy well](agents/index.qmd):** a benchmark of whether AI models make value-maximising purchase decisions, scored against the exact optimum.
- **[Prediction ledger](predictions/index.qmd):** predictions sealed before the fact, time-stamped on Bitcoin.
- **[Essays](essays/index.qmd):** longer pieces built on that data.
